questions.q: What are the four parts of the capstone portfolio this lesson describes?
options: Resume, cover letter, references, and certifications
Company and requirements; configuration; operations and crisis; review against requirements
A single Income Statement with no supporting narrative
Four unrelated Oracle Fusion screenshots
questions.explain: The portfolio is built from four already-completed parts of the capstone: the company and requirements, the configuration, the operations month and crisis, and the final review.

questions.q: What does this lesson recommend doing with the six-problem month-end crisis when discussing this project in an interview?
options: Omitting it entirely to appear more competent
Presenting it as a strength, since it demonstrates the ability to diagnose and fix real problems, not just configure correctly the first time
Blaming it entirely on other team members
Describing it only as a minor, unimportant detail
questions.explain: The lesson explicitly argues against hiding the crisis, framing it instead as the most interview-relevant part of the entire capstone.

questions.q: According to this lesson, what should a portfolio reader be able to understand within about five minutes?
options: The complete Oracle Fusion Cloud release notes
Exactly what you built, what went wrong, and what you did about it
Every quiz question from all 25 lessons
The entire career path's course catalog
questions.explain: The portfolio is designed to be read quickly while still conveying the full arc: what was built, what went wrong, and how it was resolved.

questions.q: What does completing this lesson mark for the Oracle Fusion Financials Consultant path?
options: The halfway point of the path
The completion of the Capstone stage and the entire hands-on portion of the path
The start of the Enterprise Structures course
Nothing — there are more capstone lessons after this one
questions.explain: This is explicitly the final lesson of the capstone and of the hands-on portion of the entire path.

questions.q: What course comes next in the Oracle Fusion Financials Consultant path after this capstone?
options: Oracle Fusion Enterprise Structures and Chart of Accounts
Troubleshooting Oracle Financials
Oracle Financials Career & Interview Preparation
Accounting Fundamentals for Oracle Professionals
questions.explain: Oracle Financials Career & Interview Preparation is the path's final course, covering interview prep, resume guidance, and how to present this exact capstone.
